svg.aria-label: Architecture of the Agentic MCP Lab: trainees reach n8n, Flowise, Langflow and Open WebUI; every agent calls models through LiteLLM (lab-chat) and Check Point tools either through the Bearer-protected MCP Gateway or directly on 14 MCP sidecars, which call the Management API, Gaia, Check Point cloud services or CPInfo files; secrets flow from .env or 1Password into the services at start; opt-in profiles add the security lab, AI-Infra-Guard, exercises, evals, PolicyPilot and GPU.
